card.title: Relabel carried helmets as a new class and retrain
card.rationale: Safety officer: only a worn helmet counts (9% of helmet boxes are carried helmets)

responses.message: Doable in about 6 days: we would find and relabel roughly 1,900 carried-helmet boxes (9% of 21,000), update the annotation guide, retrain YOLOv8n and re-review the 400-image eval set. It supports the "worn only" rule and fits the 3-week pilot, but the AI Engineer must update the compliance logic for the new class. A cheaper first step is an untested post-processing rule that only counts a helmet if its box overlaps the top of a head box. It needs no retraining and takes about 1.5 days.
evidence: ds/experiment-log.md › Error analysis on model v3

responses.message: The change fits the rule that a helmet counts only when worn (r-worn). We need to update the compliance logic and the app reason text for the new class. The baseline is 3 days, but a similar class change in Sep 2026 took 4 days against a 2-day estimate, so plan for 4-6 days, plus the Data Scientist's relabel and retrain time. A cheaper option is a head-position check on the existing helmet box, with no retrain.
evidence: engineer/change-history.md › Sep 2026: added a new class to the model output (person)

responses.message: The change matches rule r-worn: a helmet counts only when worn on the head. My side only needs about 1–2 days to update the rule wording and define "carried helmet" as a violation. The larger work (annotation guide, relabeling about 9% of helmet boxes, retraining, the evaluation set, and compliance logic) sits with the Data Scientist and AI Engineer, and it puts the 3-week pilot at risk.
evidence: shared/meeting-notes.md › Site visit with the safety officer (Oct 2026)
shared/project-brief.md › Success metrics agreed with the client

conflicts.text: Client promise: pilot on 2 sites in 3 weeks

alternative.label: Keep the current classes and treat 'helmet' with no head overlap as a violation. This is a rule in the compliance logic, with the carried-helmet cases added to the evaluation set only. No retrain before the pilot.
